verdict.rationale: Vue's own docs explicitly describe a 'truly reactive, compiler-optimized rendering system that rarely requires manual optimization' (vue-docs-4), directly matching the story of a compiler translating components into efficient DOM updates without manual diffing. Community sentiment corroborates strong reactivity/performance experience (vue-comm-3, vue-comm-5, vue-comm-13) though none deep-dive into the compiler internals. Missing for 10: independent technical benchmarks or detailed third-party analysis of the compiler's diffing/patch algorithm, and no first-party deep-dive doc excerpt beyond a summary claim.
